narration_timeline.text: These goats are spread across a grassy hillside, but feeding is not their only activity.
narration_timeline.scene: Visible managed goat group on grassy Sunnyvale hillside.

narration_timeline.text: A different herd moves over rocky ground, looking for the next place to stop.
narration_timeline.scene: Goat herd on rocky terrain in a different location.

narration_timeline.text: Some goats eat hay, while others choose grass in another open field.
narration_timeline.scene: Two real clips of domestic goats feeding on hay and grass.

narration_timeline.text: Between meals, goats may pause to groom, yawn, or simply rest for a while.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate close footage of goat grooming and goats yawning in a managed setting.

narration_timeline.text: Newborn kids have another priority: getting milk from their mother before they can graze.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual newborn goats nursing or staying close to mother.

narration_timeline.text: From small kids to roaming adults, a goat herd is always doing more than eating.
narration_timeline.scene: Domestic goat in open grassy area.
